notes.title: 1.59版本 发布
notes.content:
预计发布时间2019.7.26   中午


--------------------------
本次更新：
1.新的小游戏
2.每个场景都会有新加入的角色；
公寓中增加了些[b]新邻居[/b]，每个新邻居都有自己的故事
3.新的作物种子
4.本次更新，将不对图片进行加密，[b]你可以自己替换游戏中角色的立绘[/b]


----------------------

notes.title: About bugs and update
notes.content:
to dear players~~~~


1.bug
Emmmm, because I am making this game by myself, so I have to do music, write scripts, and draw something...

Therefore, it is inevitable that you will have problems while playing. If there is a bug, or if you have any suggestions, please don't judge it easily~~~(A bad review may lead to inconvenient work in these months), you can contact me. Feedback, I will deal with it in time, and give you a small gift to express my gratitude to you.


2. Update
Updates will definitely be there, I will always add something interesting.
You can also give me your thoughts.
